address: 431-433 Tanao Road, Sao Chingcha, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: This iconic family-run eatery serves delectable mango sticky rice made to a recipe that has been handed down the generations for 80 years. Their preparation is masterful: the flavour of the steamed sweetened sticky rice is enhanced by the richness of coconut milk....
